desc: Understand the math: T(i,j) transformation, maximum slope interpretation.
Implement the upper convex hull algorithm and compute max slope as described.
Test the provided sample inputs (1–4) and verify the output matches expected results.
Test edge cases: N=1 (should output -1), buildings with descending heights, and ensure non-negative output when applicable.
Double-check the hull construction: ensure slopes are computed correctly and the pop condition preserves the upper hull (slopes strictly decreasing).
Ensure output format uses 18 decimal places and handles -1 correctly when max_slope < 0.
Test random cases against a brute-force O(N^2) solution for small N to confirm correctness.
